sources.title: Synthetic funding registry entry
sources.passage: A synthetic registry lists an Example Labs seed round dated 2024-04-10 with a reported INR 2 crore amount. The transaction completion status is unknown, and the entry does not state current cash availability.

sources.title: Synthetic company product statement
sources.passage: Example Labs states that its pilot software was launched in 2025-08. This is a company statement; the page does not report independently verified customers, revenue, or signed contracts.

sources.title: Synthetic later financing entry
sources.passage: A later synthetic registry entry dated 2026-02-19 labels an Example Labs financing event Series B. The entry provides no amount and gives its completion status as unknown; its label conflicts with treating the company as currently at seed stage.
